stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=comps(g)
    # bar: multi-color comp with small bbox
    bars=[c for c in cs if len({g[y][x] for y,x in c})>1]
    bar=max(bars,key=lambda c:min((y+x)*2 for y,x in c)) if False else None
    bar=min(bars,key=lambda c:max(y for y,x in c)-min(y for y,x in c)+max(x for y,x in c)-min(x for y,x in c))
    bcol=[g[y][x] for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[1])]
    for y,x in bar: o[y][x]=0
    exist={bcol[j] for j,c in enumerate(bcol) if c in {next(iter({g[a][b] for a,b in c2})) for c2 in cs if len({g[y][x] for y,x in c2})==1}}
    mid=(min(exist)+max(exist))/2
    aidx=bcol.index(min(exist,key=lambda e:abs(e-mid)))
    col=bcol[aidx]; a=next(c for c in cs if next(iter({g[y][x] for y,x in c}))==col)
    ty=min(y for y,x in a); tx=min(x for y,x in a); oh=max(y for y,x in a)-ty+1
    mask={(y-ty,x-tx) for y,x in a}
    for k,c in enumerate(bcol):
        if c==col: continue
        src=min((t for t,e in enumerate(exist)),key=lambda t:abs(t-k))
        s=next(c2 for c2 in cs if next(iter({g[y][x] for y,x in c2}))==bcol[src])
        t2=min(y for y,x in s); t1=min(x for y,x in s); oh2=max(y for y,x in s)-t2+1
        m2={(y-t2,x-t1) for y,x in s}
        tt=t2+(k-src)*oh2
        for dy,dx in m2:
            yy,xx=tt+dy,t1+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: o[yy][xx]=c
    return o

# Verify f(demos) with corrected comps logic:
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=comps(g)
    bars=[c for c in cs if len({g[y][x] for y,x in c})>1]
    bar=min(bars,key=lambda c:max(y for y,x in c)-min(y for y,x in c)+max(x for y,x in c)-min(x for y,x in c))
    bcol=[g[y][x] for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[1])] if len({y for y,x in bar})>1==0 else None
    # bar shape: vertical if taller than wide
    ys={y for y,x in bar}; xs={x for y,x in bar}
    if len(ys)>len(xs): bcol=[g[y][x] for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[0])]
    else: bcol=[g[y][x] for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[1])]
    for y,x in bar: o[y][x]=0
    uni={}
    for c in cs:
        if c is bar: continue
        cols={g[y][x] for y,x in c}
        if len(cols)==1:
            v=next(iter(cols)); uni[v]=c
    exist=[bcol[j] for j,c in enumerate(bcol) if c in uni]
    mid=(min(exist)+max(exist))/2
    ai=bcol.index(min(exist,key=lambda e:abs(e-mid))) if False else min(exist,key=lambda e:abs(e-mid)) if 1 in bcol else None
    # anchor = '1' if present in bcol, else middle
    if 1 in bcol: ai=bcol.index(1)
    col=bcol[ai]; a=uni[col]
    ty=min(y for y,x in a); tx=min(x for y,x in a); oh=max(y for y,x in a)-ty+1
    mask={(y-ty,x-tx) for y,x in a}
    for k,c in enumerate(bcol):
        if c==col: continue
        src=min([t for t,e in enumerate(bcol) if e in uni],key=lambda t:abs(t-k))
        s=uni[bcol[src]]; t2=min(y for y,x in s); t1=min(x for y,x in s); oh2=max(y for y,x in s)-t2+1
        m2={(y-t2,x-t1) for y,x in s}
        tt=t2+(k-src)*oh2
        for dy,dx in m2:
            yy,xx=tt+dy,t1+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: o[yy][xx]=c
    return o

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=comps(g)
    bars=[c for c in cs if len({g[y][x] for y,x in c})>1]
    bar=max(bars,key=len)
    bcells={(y,x) for y,x in bar}
    bcol=[g[y][x] for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[0])]
    for y,x in bar: o[y][x]=0
    def mask(c):
        return sorted((y,x) for cc in cs if cc is not bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c and (y,x) not in bcells)
    masks={c:mask(c) for c in bcol}
    # stack order = bar order; existing shapes stay; missing colors fill their bar-position slot adjacent to the nearest existing shape
    shp=[i for i,c in enumerate(bcol) if len(masks[c])>3]
    if not shp: return o
    ref=min(shp)  # anchor: color 1 if present else middle
    for i,c in enumerate(bcol):
        if len(masks[c])>3: continue
        # partner: existing shape index nearest in bar order (either side, whichever closer)
        best=None
        for j in range(len(bcol)):
            if len(masks[bcol[j]])>3 and abs(j-i)<best or (j!=ref and len(masks[bcol[j]])>3): pass
        for j in range(len(bcol)):
            if j!=i and len(masks[bcol[j]])>3:
                if best is None or abs(j-i)<abs(best[0]-i): best=j
        if best is None: continue
        pm=masks[bcol[best]]; 
        top=min(y for y,x in pm); bot=max(y for y,x in pm)
        amask=masks[bcol[ref]]
        # side away from anchor: compare anchor mid to partner mid
        amid=sum(y for y,x in amask)/len(amask)
        pmid=sum(y for y,x in pm)/len(pm)
        dy=-(bot+1) if pmid<amid else (bot+1)
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h: o[yy][x]=c
    return o

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=regcomps(g)
    bar=None
    for cc in cs:
        ys=[y for y,x in cc]; xs=[x for y,x in cc]
        if len({g[y][x] for y,x in cc})>1 and min(max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1)<=3:
            bar=cc
    seq=[]; seen=set()
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:p[0]):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def mask(c):
        return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:mask(c) for c in set(seq)}
    shp=[i for i,c in enumerate(set(seq)) if len(masks[c])>3]
    if not shp: return o
    ref=min(shp)
    # chain rows: existing shapes occupy vertical span; insert missing colors at their bar index
    top=sum(y for y,x in masks[seq[ref]])/len(masks[seq[ref]])
    bot=max(y for y,x in masks[seq[ref]])
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if len(masks[v])>3 or i==ref: continue
        # partner = nearest existing shape index
        best=min(((j,i>j),j) for j in shp if j!=i)[1]
        pm=masks[seq[best]]
        midpm=sum(y for y,x in pm)/len(pm)
        dy=-(max(y for y,x in pm)+1) if i<best else (min(y for y,x in pm)-1)
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h: o[yy][x]=v
    return o

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=regcomps(g)
    bar=None
    for cc in cs:
        ys=[y for y,x in cc]; xs=[x for y,x in cc]
        if len({g[y][x] for y,x in cc})>1 and max(max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1)<=4:
            bar=cc
    seen=set(); seq=[]
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def sc(c): return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:sc(c) for c in set(seq)}
    ext=[j for j,c in enumerate(set(seq)) if len(masks[c])>3]
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if i in ext: continue
        left=[j for j in ext if j<i]; right=[j for j in ext if j>i]
        if not right and not left: continue
        j = min(right) if right else max(left)
        pm=masks[seq[j]]
        ph=max(y for y,x in pm)-min(y for y,x in pm)+1
        if right:   # before partner -> above it, flush: stamp bottom = partner top - 1
            dy = -ph  # stamp occupies [top-?]: stamp top = partner_top - ph, i.e., bottom at partner_top-1

            dy = (max(y for y,x in pm) + 1)
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h and o[yy][x]==0: o[yy][x]=v

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=regcomps(g)
    bar=None
    for cc in cs:
        ys=[y for y,x in cc]; xs=[x for y,x in cc]
        if len({g[y][x] for y,x in cc})>1 and max(max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1)<=4:
            bar=cc
    seen=set(); seq=[]
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def sc(c): return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:sc(c) for c in set(seq)}
    ext=[j for j,c in enumerate(set(seq)) at 3]
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if i in ext: continue
        right=[j for j in ext if j>i]; left=[j for j in ext if j<i]
        if not right and not left: continue
        j = min(right) if right else max(left)
        pm=masks[seq[j]]
        pt, pb = min(y for y,x in pm), max(y for y,x in pm)
        # partner stamp's full bbox: extend via its stamp extent (same as mask since it IS the stamp)
        hh = pb-pt+1
        if j>i:   # before partner in bar -> sit just above partner stamp
            dy = (pt - 1) - pb
        else:     # after -> just below partner stamp
            dy = (pb + 1) - pt
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h and o[yy][x]==0: o[yy][x]=v
    return o

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=regcomps(g)
    bar=None
    for cc in cs:
        ys=[y for y,x in cc]; xs=[x for y,x in cc]
        if len({g[y][x] for y,x in cc})>1 and max(max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1)<=4:
            bar=cc
    seen=set(); seq=[]
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def sc(c): return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:sc(c) for c in set(seq)}
    ext=[j for j,c in enumerate(set(seq)) if len(masks[c])>3]
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if i in ext: continue
        right=[j for j in ext if j>i]; left=[j for j in ext if j<i]
        if not right and not left: continue
        j = min(right) if right else max(left)
        pm=masks[seq[j]]
        pt,pb=min(y for y,x in pm),max(y for y,x in pm)
        ph=max(y for y,x in pm)-min(y for y,x in pm)+1
        if j>i:   # before partner -> sit flush above partner stamp
            dy=(pt-ph)
        else:     # after -> flush below
            dy=(pb+1)
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h and o[yy][x]==0: o[yy][x]=v
    for y,x in bar: o[y][x]=0
    return o

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=rc(g)

            bar=cc
    seen=set(); seq=[]
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def sc(c): return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:sc(c) for c in set(seq)}
    ext=[j for j,c in enumerate(set(seq)) if len(masks[c])>3]

        pm=masks[seq[j]]

        if j>i:   # missing comes before partner -> stamped just above partner stamp

        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy

    for y,x in bar: o[y][x]=0

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=rc(g)
    bar=None
    for cc in cs:
        ys=[p[0] for p in cc]; xs=[p[1] for p in cc]
        if len({g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in cc})>1 and max(max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1)<=4 and len(cc)<25:
            bar=cc
    seen=set(); seq=[]
    for y,x in sorted(bar,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        v=g[y][x]
        if v not in seen: seen.add(v); seq.append(v)
    def sc(c): return {(y,x) for cc in cs if cc!=bar for y,x in cc if g[y][x]==c}
    masks={c:sc(c) for c in set(seq)}
    ext=[j for j,c in enumerate(set(seq)) if len(masks[c])>3]
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if i in ext: continue
        right=[j for j in ext if j>i]; left=[j for j in ext if j<i]
        if not right and not left: continue
        j = min(right) if right else max(left)
        pm=masks[seq[j]]
        pt,pb=min(y for y,x in pm),max(y for y,x in pm)
        ph=max(x for _,x in pm)-min(x for _,x in pm)+1
        # place copy of partner stamp adjacent to partner on the side facing the bar (top if bar above, below if bar below)
        if j>i:   # color before partner -> above
            dy=(pt-ph)-(pt)
            dy=-(ph-1)
        else:     # after -> below
            dy=(pb+1)-(pt)
        for y,x in pm:
            yy=y+dy
            if 0<=yy<h and o[yy][x]==0: o[yy][x]=v
    return o
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(name, f(G[name+' input'])==G[name+' output'])
